en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with three interior photographs of elegant rooms (reception room, dining hall, and breakfast room) of a military officers' casino. At left is a decorative illustration with crossed rifles, a hunting horn, and antlers with a crown. The photos are captioned in German, and a large red title reads "Dresden." The main text names the officers' casino of the Royal Saxon 2nd Jäger Battalion No. 13.
